source.annotated_scope: Focal 239 butterfly panel. Analysis-ready, source-derived full accepted HOSTS/WCVP native and contemporary plant×WGSRPD3 sidecars and additional BCE/Clarke accepted-plant IDs; frozen CHELSA climate crossfit and exact original TDWG boundary data; optional original HOSTS MCMC draw series.

independently_reproduced.direct_identifier_scan: PASS; checks include known author handle, name, email patterns, but manual privacy review is still required

claim_ceiling: Offline reproduction of analytic sidecars, not regeneration of raw WCVP or HOSTS bulk providers; upstream R reconstruction scripts and external pinned source IDs included.
Only original HOSTS climate/local-range null full 2×99 MCMC series is included, not a BCE-source-aware local-null reanalysis.
This source archive is designed for author internal review; no third-party redistribution licence has been cleared by this run. The exact TDWG/Kew-derived geometry licence remains ambiguous.
Code/dataset account-handle checks do not guarantee a completely double-blinded manuscript package until a human edits all document metadata and submission files.
Regional potential larval-host presence and catalogue agreement do not test butterfly feeding, reproduction, colonization or ecological competition.
